mentions.name: ComputerPoker.ai
mentions.description: This website lets users learn GTO poker strategy by playing simulated Texas Hold 'Em tournaments against GTO bots in a low-risk environment, with real-time feedback on decisions as they play. It includes GTO pre-flop quizzes and pre-flop charts, grades users on covered pre-flop scenarios, and grades post-flop decisions using a PyTorch MLP model that approximates GTO play, trained on data from an in-house Rust CFR++ solver. The stack is Django on AWS via Terraform and SaltStack, Postgres RDS, and HTMX with WebSockets via Django Channels and Redis.
mentions.problem: Professional poker tools for learning GTO play can be overwhelming; for some tools, learning to operate the tool itself felt like a second job. ComputerPoker.ai instead teaches GTO strategy through play against bots, with no knobs or dials to configure.
mentions.source_excerpt: ComputerPoker.ai is a website where users can play simulated poker tournaments against GTO Bots to learn GTO poker strategy in a fun and low-risk environment.
